THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Revocation of Order under Section 4(1)

WHEREAS by Order made under Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (Revised Edition 1956), as amended by Acts, Nos. 14 and 62 of 1957, 14 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 read with Industrial Disputes (Special Provisions) Act, No. 37 of 1968 dated 17.02.2023 and published in the Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka Extraordinary No. 2320/53 dated 22.02.2023 of the Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter speciﬁ ed in the statement of the Commissioner General of Labour dated 31.01.2023.
Mr. W.A.D.P. Perera, T/5, Diyawanna Garden, Thalangama - South, Battaramulla. and
National Water Supply and Drainage Board, No. 14, Galle Road, Rathmalana.
was referred to Mr. Kumarasingha Amaranath Perera Rajakaruna Attorney-at-law for settlement by arbitration.

AND whereas it is now deemed expedient that the said Order be revoked, due to Mr. Kumarasingha Amaranath Perera Rajakaruna Attorney - at - Law, the Arbitrator informing that he is resigning from this dispute, Dr. Anil Jayantha Fernando, Minister of Labour do hereby revoke the said Order and further make Order that no proceedings be taken upon the said Order dated 17.02.2023.
Dr. ANIL JAYANTHA FERNANDO, Minister of Labour.Colombo.25th March 2025,

THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Order under Section 4(1)
WHEREAS AN Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter speciﬁ ed in the statement of the Commissioner General of Labour which accompanies this order exists between.
Mr. W.A.D.P. Perera, T/5, Diyawanna Garden, Thalangama - South, Battaramulla. and
National Water Supply and Drainage Board, No. 14, Galle Road, Rathmalana.

NOW THEREFORE I, Dr. Anil Jayantha Fernando, Minister of Labour do by virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition), as amended by Acts Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes - Special Provisions) Act No. 37 of 1968 hereby appoint.
Mr. Piyal Darshana Guruge, Attorney-at-law, No. 04, Richard De Soysa Housing Scheme, Koswatta, Battaramulla.
to be the arbitrator and refer the aforesaid dispute to him for settlement by arbitration.
Dr. ANIL JAYANTHA FERNANDO, Minister of Labour.Colombo.25th March 2025,My No.: IR/COM/04/2019/328.
THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Mr. W.A.D.P. Perera, T/5, Diyawanna Garden, Thalangama - South, Battaramulla. and
National Water Supply and Drainage Board, No. 14, Galle Road, Rathmalana.
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether Mr. W.A.D.P. Perera working as a Driver in the National Water Supply and Drainage Board has been caused injustice by being transferred as a punishment, before the concusion of the disciplinary inquiry conducted against him and if so, to what relief he is entitled.
H.K.K.A. JAYASUNDARA, Commissioner General of Labour.
Dated at the ofﬁ ce of the Commissioner General of Labour,Colombo, on this 12th day of March, 2025.
